name: Golem, Silver
body:
Silver Golem CR 6

XP 2,400
N Large construct
Init +3; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +0

DEFENSE

AC 23, touch 9, flat-footed 23 (+14 natural, -1 size)
hp 67 (10d10+22)
Fort +2, Ref +3, Will +4
DR 5/adamantine; Immune construct traits, magic

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee 2 slams +19 (2d8+7)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 24; Dex 11, Con —, Int —; Wis 11; Cha 1
Base Atk +12; CMB +20; CMD 30

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary or gang (2–4)
Treasure none

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Fast Healing

Silver golems have fast healing 6.

Immunity to Magic (Ex)

A silver golem is immune to any spell or spell-like ability that allows spell resistance. In addition, certain spells and effects function differently against the creature, as noted below.

Soften earth and stone causes a silver golem to lose its damage reduction and fast healing for 5 rounds.

A silver golem has an solidly crafted humanoid body. Like most golems, a silver golem cannot speak and makes grinding sounds when it moves. A silver golem is 9 feet tall and weighs around 2,200 pounds. A silver golem’s body is an amalgam of silver and other metals, and is molded from a single mold.

Crafting this Golem

CL 11th; Price 77,000 gp

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Construct; Spells animate objects, geas/quest, rapid repair; Special creator must be caster level 11th; Skill Checks Craft (silversmithing) or Craft (jewelrymaking) DC 21; Cost 39,000 gp
